coordinate_system.illustrator_conversion: 1 mm = 72 / 25.4 pt; generated Illustrator coordinates use points

material.back_and_edge: paper base color in a later model-generation stage

layers.PF_CUT: closed outer contours and closed hole contours; stroke only
layers.PF_PRINT_FRONT: one-sided printable artwork in the same part-local coordinates as PF_CUT
layers.PF_ANNOTATION: non-geometric labels and dimensions; ignored by geometry import
layers.PF_FOLD: reserved and intentionally empty in this prototype

small_sample.print_orientation_marker: orange arrow and cyan bar make top/bottom and left/right mirroring visible

assembly_trial_values_mm.note: Trial values only. They are explicit input for a later placement stage, not a real-job drawing specification.
